title: Rabbi Chanin bar Levi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah, beginning of chapter 4, in a halakhah. In Ruth Rabbah 5:11: “Rabbi Chanin bar Levi said: She is a Moabite.” Hyman explains that Boaz said to Ruth, “Stay close to my maidens” (Ruth 2:8), but when Ruth told Naomi she said that Boaz had told her, “Stay close to my young men,” because she could not speak Hebrew well; and Naomi corrected her words and said, “It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his maidens.”
